Illustrated experiment: a learned word/button association in game A becomes a hypothesis in game B. Three independent beneficial starting-state roots are required on each side before the transfer is supported. Image is embedded in this HTML as JPEG bytes; no external image file, CDN, or internet connection is required. This is a conceptual story panel, not a screenshot or claim of successful commercial-game transfer.
